parsed.summary: The front-end implementation correctly reflects all specified changes in PLAN-B72 for backtest defaults, new strategy summary cards, and new dynamic strategy sections. Default values for backtest parameters (stop loss, take profit, max hold) are updated in both single-stock and batch backtest forms. New UI cards and sections for '全部策略 5 年回測', '盤中假跌破', '研究候選快觸發', and '研究候選重測' are added and conditionally rendered based on the selected strategy. XSS protection is consistently applied to all dynamic content. Edge cases and error handling for API calls appear robust.
parsed.coverage: All front-end related changes described in PLAN-B72 sections B, C, D, and E are covered and correctly implemented in the `front.diff`. The `switchTab('screen')` and `renderScreenTable()` functions are updated to trigger the loading and rendering of new components as per the plan. Backtest parameter defaults in `_btParams()` and `_batchQuery()` are updated.
parsed.limitations: The review is based solely on the provided `front.diff` and `PLAN-B72.md`. Backend implementation details for data fetching, strategy logic, and push notifications (e.g., global_brief.py, fbd_live.py, changes to PRICE_STRATEGY_FNS, STRATEGY_KEYS) were not part of this code inspection, though their integration points on the front-end were verified.
